name: TAF Inpatient Outcomes
description: Processed inpatient outcomes dataset derived from the TAF Inpatient Claims files. Contains beneficiary-level hospitalization events with admission and discharge information, diagnosis codes, and associated payment data for Medicaid enrollees.

license.name: No license, user must be under Data User Agreement (DUA)

name: TAF Inpatient Outcomes File
description: Processed, beneficiary-level inpatient outcomes derived from the TAF Inpatient Claims. Each record represents a single hospitalization event for a Medicaid enrollee, including admission and discharge details, primary and secondary diagnoses, and payment information.

content.year: Int32: Reference year of the claim
content.los_day_cnt: Int32: Length of stay in days (discharge date minus admission date)
content.admsn_type_cd: String: Admission type code (e.g., emergency, urgent, elective, newborn)
content.primary_diagnosis: String: Primary diagnosis code (ICD-10-CM) for the admission
content.diagnoses: List<String>: All diagnosis codes associated with the admission
content.mdcd_pd_amt: Double: Total Medicaid payment amount for the claim
content.tot_mdcr_ddctbl_amt: Double: Medicare deductible amount (for dual-eligible beneficiaries)
content.admsn_day_of_week: Int32: Day of week of admission (1=Sunday, 7=Saturday)
content.admission_year: Int32: Calendar year of hospital admission
content.non_external_primary: Int32: Flag indicating whether primary diagnosis is a non-external cause (1 = yes, 0 = no)
content.non_external_all: List<Int32>: Flags indicating whether each diagnosis code is a non-external cause
